units.source_text: 名人、七段和我要是同住在一家旅馆里，我就很难撰写这些人的事。

en.t: If the Master, the seventh-dan player, and I were staying at the same inn, it would be very hard for me to write about them.

units.source_text: 即使同在箱根，我也要从宫下到塔之泽下榻，

en.t: Even if we were all in Hakone, I had to leave Miyanoshita and take lodging at Tonosawa,

units.source_text: 一方面要继续撰写这些人的事，一方面又要在下次对弈日同这些人照面，甚感不便。

en.t: because it was extremely awkward to go on writing about them while also having to face them again on the next day of play.

units.source_text: 这是报社主办的围棋的观战记，为了宣传鼓动读者，也只得斗胆舞弄点文墨了。

en.t: This was a go match report sponsored by the newspaper, and to promote it and stir the readers, I had no choice but to boldly make a little show with my pen.

units.source_text: 外行人哪会熟悉高段的棋艺呢，

en.t: How could an outsider be familiar with the skill of high-ranking players,

units.source_text: 而且一盘棋要连载六七十天，只好着重描写棋手的风采和举止了。

en.t: and since a single game had to be serialized for sixty or seventy days, I could only emphasize the players' presence and behavior.

units.source_text: 与其说我是观棋，不如说我是观察下棋的人。

en.t: Rather than saying I was watching the game, it would be truer to say I was observing the people who played it.

units.source_text: 另外，对局的棋手是主人，工作人员和观战记者都是仆从。

en.t: Moreover, the players in the match were the masters, while the staff and the match reporters were all attendants.
I was not especially well versed in go,

units.source_text: 要非常郑重地撰写下去就得对棋手抱有敬爱之情，除此以外别无他途。

en.t: so to continue writing with real seriousness, I had to hold the players in reverence and affection; there was no other way.

units.source_text: 不仅棋赛的胜负让我非常感兴趣，棋道也令我深受感动。

en.t: It was not only the outcome of the match that deeply interested me; the way of go itself also moved me profoundly.

units.source_text: 这是因为我能忘却自己而凝视名人之故。

en.t: This was because I could forget myself and gaze intently at the Master.
